transcript: This man who lost his ability to speak just told his wife I, I love you. Oh my God! All because of Elon, and it's the most beautiful thing I've seen on the internet today. Here's how Elon made it happen. This man, Terry, has ALS, a disease that affected his ability to speak. But two technologies just allowed him to regain his voice: Neuralink and Grok Voice. I'll explain. So Terry signed up to be the third patient to get Neuralink's voice trial. If you don't know how Neuralink works, they implant a tiny chip inside the brain that can pick up electrical signals from neurons, and these signals contain information about what we're trying to do. For Terry, Neuralink is trying to decode the brain activity associated with speech. So first, Terry tried to mimic speaking as best as he could. The system watched the patterns of neural activity in his brain and learned which patterns connected to different speech sounds and words. After that, Terry didn't even need to try to physically speak anymore. He could simply think about saying something. Neuralink would pick up those neural signals, decode what he was trying to say, and turn them into words. But here's where it gets really interesting. Normally, the next step would be to turn those words into a generic computer-generated voice, like the one Stephen Hawking had. But Neuralink teamed up with Grok Voice to do something much more personal. They used recordings of Terry's voice from before ALS affected his speech to recreate his old voice. So now, Terry looks at his wife and says this: I, I love you. Oh my God! This isn't just about making a computer obey your thoughts, it's about giving someone who lost their ability to speak sound like themselves again. Of course, this is still an experimental clinical trial, and results can vary between participants. But if this technology keeps improving, the future could be incredible. One day, your brain might not just control a computer, it could become your new vocal cords. If you enjoyed this and want more such stories around AI, join my free WhatsApp community, link in bio.
